earnings.title: Evergy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results, Declares Quarterly Dividend and Raises 2026 Guidance
highlights: Third Quarter 2026 GAAP EPS of $2.59, compared to $2.03 in 2025
Third Quarter 2026 Adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) of $2.58, compared to $2.03

Evergy’s third quarter 2026 adjusted earnings (non-GAAP) and adjusted earnings per share (non-GAAP) were $609.9 million and $2.58 per share, respectively, compared to $475.1 million and $2.03, respectively, in third quarter 2025.
Declares quarterly dividend of $0.7225 per share
We increased our dividend by 4%, which
outlook: Raises 2026 Adjusted (non-GAAP) EPS guidance to $4.35 to $4.50 from

The Company raised its 2026 adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) guidance range to $4.35 to $4.50 from its original guidance range

Additionally, the Company reaffirmed its long-term adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) annual growth target of 6% to 8%+ through 2030 based on the original 2026 adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) guidance midpoint of $4.24.
